decisions.scenario: Finding a Tuesday afternoon train from Kings Lynn to Cambridge after 14:15

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: I need a train from Kings Lynn to Cambridge on Tuesday, leaving after 14:15.

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: Train TR8932 leaves Kings Lynn at 15:11.

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: How long does the journey take?

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: Great, that’s all I need. Thanks!

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: You’re welcome. Have a great day.

decisions.notes: Retained because TR8932, its 15:11 Tuesday departure, and 47-minute journey add a new Kings Lynn-to-Cambridge schedule combination.
